description: Labels such as public, internal, confidential and restricted, plus a personal-data flag, attached to fields and documents so code can decide what may travel.
Personal data collected for one purpose is not reused for another without its own legal basis. Every AI use case declares its purpose.
The lawful ground for processing personal data: consent, contract, legitimate interest, legal obligation and others (GDPR Art. 6, LGPD Art. 7).
Sending only the fields a purpose needs, by allowlist, so new or unexpected data stays out of prompts by default.
How long outputs, traces and memories derived from personal data may be kept, set by the purpose and enforced by a job.
A record of who, which purpose, which fields, when and until when, written at each model call; the evidence behind retention and erasure.
